Final review complete; no further corrections needed. All host acceptance and upstream regression tests passed.

Summary of the fix (src/dotenv/parser.py only):
- `parse_binding` now captures the `_equal_sign` match and passes `preceded_by_whitespace=len(equal_sign) > 1` into `parse_value`. Since `_equal_sign = r"(=[^\S\r\n]*)"` captures `=` plus any trailing spaces/tabs, a length > 1 means whitespace separated `=` from the value.
- `parse_value` gained the `preceded_by_whitespace` flag (default `False`). When the next char is `#` and whitespace preceded it, it returns `""` (inline comment); the subsequent `_comment` regex consumes the comment text.

Behavior confirmed:
- `KEY= # explanation` → `""`
- `KEY=#literal` → `"#literal"` (no preceding whitespace)
- `KEY=a#b` → `"a#b"`
- Quoting, `export`, and ordinary full-line comments unchanged; the default flag preserves all other call paths.

Remaining limitations: none identified. The change is scoped to the parser and does not alter tests, docs, other modules, or dependencies.
